item.title: Data Scientist - Bedrock Robotics
item.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world
At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.
In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic
In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.
This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.
**The Role** Bedrock Robotics is hiring a Data Scientist to lead high-impact data science work across autonomy, safety, and product. In this role, you will operate as a senior technical individual contributor, partnering closely with autonomy, machine learning, backend, and product teams to extract insights from complex, real-world data generated by autonomous construction machines and their operators.
You will work across the full data science lifecycle (problem framing, analysis, measurement, and communication) while helping establish foundational practices for how data science is applied at Bedrock. This role is ideal for a senior-to-staff-level data scientist who enjoys operating in ambiguous problem spaces, working close to production systems, and delivering insights that directly influence engineering and product decisions.
**What You'll Do**
* Own and execute data science work across autonomy, safety, and product, focusing on the highest-impact analytical problems * Analyze machine telemetry, operational data, and user workflows to surface insights that improve system performance, safety, and usability * Define and track key metrics that measure system behavior and product outcomes * Design and evaluate experiments, analyses, and validation approaches in partnership with engineering and product teams * Collaborate closely with ML platform and data engineering teams to ensure data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analysis * Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing roadmap and design decisions * Contribute to the foundation of data science practices at Bedrock, helping shape how future work and teams scale
**Required Qualifications**
* 5+ years of experience in data science, applied analytics, or applied machine learning roles * Comfort operating as a senior IC in a fast-growing startup, balancing execution with technical judgment and prioritization * Ability to work independently, define analytical approaches, and drive projects from concept to insight * Experience working with complex, high-volume, or real-time data (e.g., robotics, autonomy, geospatial systems, computer vision outputs, IoT, ad-tech, or large-scale consumer platforms) * Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and data analysis, with a track record of influencing decisions through data * Hands-on experience collaborating with data engineering and infrastructure teams on data pipelines, data quality, and scalable analysis workflows * Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using modern tooling like agentic AI * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (advanced degree welcome but not required)
**Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.
**Reasonable Accommodations** We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.

item.title: Lead Principal Applied Scientist - Oracle
item.description:
**Job Description** Partners with science, engineering, and product experts and leaders to identify strategic business and product needs, and drives and plans the identification of solutions to address product and/or business problems. Leads the design and execution of research programs; surveying state of the art, preparing high-quality datasets, running POCs/experiments, and designing, training, and optimizing ML/AI models and solution architectures. Guides technical teams to deliver and deploy solutions into production, and ensures delivered solutions successfully solve product and/or business problems. Participates in the research community by publishing and presenting research findings and serving as a keynote speaker.
**Responsibilities** **Key Responsibilities** **Solution Identification:** –Partners with science, engineering, and product experts and leaders to establish processes for teams to identify and address strategic business and product needs related to the use of machine learning (ML) and/or artificial intelligence (AI).
–Evaluates the literature and market to understand the difficulty and scope of problems. Leverages understanding and expertise to break down problems for others.
–Sets science quality standards for the Line of Business (LOB), and leads the end-to-end execution of science strategy to address product and/or business problems.
–Drives and plans the identification and prioritization of solutions based on the scientific process (e.g., including modeling approaches, evaluation techniques, data collections).
–Identifies opportunities to apply delivered solutions across product and/or business problems.
**Solution Development – Applied Research:** –Ensures research proofs-of-concept (POCs) or research experiments are designed to validate proposed solutions, gather robust supporting evidence, and assess the risks and rewards of solutions. Gains buy-in for applied research.
–Leverages subject matter expertise to establish criteria used to select and prepare datasets for use in applied research. Provides expert review of datasets to ensure high quality data is being leveraged and addresses gaps in the data.
–Leads the design and execution of research programs on new theories, tools, and methodologies to transfer and apply state-of-the-art technologies into products and services or make advancements in the field.
**Solution Development:** –Guides the design, development, and optimization of ML and AI technologies, such as model training/fine-tuning and computation optimizations.
–Leverages subject matter expertise to refine the architecture of ML and AI solutions, such as data, model, training, and evaluation, employing best practices.
**Solution Development – Articulating Research Insights:** –Identifies meaningful insights from highly complex data and metadata sources from analysis and experiments.
–Interprets and communicates insights and findings throughout Oracle.
–Leads the creation of patents, white papers, or other technical documentation related to applied research outcomes.
**Solution Delivery – Coding and Documentation:** –Evaluates and offers guidance on high-complexity code written by team and properly maintains and organizes existing codebase.
–Establishes best practices for version control, code review, and code delivery/deployment and guides less experienced team members.
–Builds, maintains, and reviews professional documentation for technical processes (experimentation, data collection and analyses, model building).
–Owns the repository for the team.
**Solution Delivery:** –Guides technical teams to ensure the successful and timely delivery of solutions and integration of services.
–Ensures successful collaboration with software engineers and/or machine learning engineers to deploy solutions into production environments.
–Leads the peer review of solutions prior to delivery.
–Coordinates the delivery of solutions with applied science team members.
–Ensures delivered solutions successfully solve product and/or business problems.
–Guides the definition of operational and user feedback metrics and analyzes metrics to inform the technical strategy of the LOB.
–Facilitates partnerships with operational teams to evaluate and monitor solutions in production.
**Building Research Capability – Research Excellence:** –Demonstrates expertise and thought leadership within Oracle in at least one business-critical applied research technology area.
–Leverages subject matter expertise to apply and guide others to apply domain knowledge and industry best practices to applied research.
**Building Research Capability – Research Community Presence:** –Leads the publication, presentation, and review of research findings and papers in top-tier conferences, research and industry outlets, etc.
–Serves as a keynote speaker in conferences or panels.
–Participates in the scientific community by providing peer review and feedback.
–Establishes collaboration with external research labs in industry, where plausible, or academia.
**Core Responsibilities** **Planning & Execution:** –Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.
–Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.
**Collaboration & Partnership:** –Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.
–Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success.
–Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.
**Problem Solving:** –Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.
–Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.
**Continuous Learning:** –Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.
–Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).
–Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.
–Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams.
–Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.
**Continuous Improvement:** –Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.
–Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.
–Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.
**Performance and Development:** –Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy.
–Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

item.title: Sr. Lead Data Scientist - Early Warning
item.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.
Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.
Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.
The Sr. Lead Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor and technical leader within the data science organization, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced machine learning and statistical solutions in a complex, high-volume, high-throughput data environment. This role plays a critical leadership function by owning end-to-end modeling initiatives, guiding analytical direction for major business problems, and mentoring data scientists across multiple projects.
This position is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence modeling standards and best practices, and partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production-ready analytics solutions.
**Essential Functions** **Advanced Modeling & Technical Leadership**
* Leads the design, experimentation, and implementation of advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to solve complex, high-impact business problems. * Serves as the technical owner for large-scale, business-critical models, including model selection, feature engineering, training strategy, validation, and performance monitoring. * Drives development of complex consumer or entity profiles used for both offline model training and real-time scoring. * Assesses and ensures long-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments. * Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team.
**Project & Cross-Functional Leadership**
* Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors. * Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies. * Translates ambiguous, high-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria. * Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy.
**Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing**
* Acts as a senior mentor and subject matter expert, coaching junior and mid-level data scientists on modeling techniques, analytical thinking, and technical execution. * Reviews analytical work, model designs, and code for quality, rigor, and alignment with best practices. * Shares knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies through documentation, presentations, and informal leadership.
**Communication & Documentation**
* Clearly documents model design, assumptions, workflows, and performance results for both technical and non-technical audiences. * Presents analytical findings, model outcomes, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence.
**Data Stewardship & Compliance**
* Supports the company’s commitment to protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of systems and data. * Ensures models and analytical solutions adhere to governance, regulatory, and ethical standards.
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field. * Typically 10+ years of professional experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, or equivalent advanced education and experience. * Extensive hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets in high-volume environments. * Advanced proficiency in data science and machine learning tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Java, or equivalent. * Deep experience with a broad range of machine learning methods, including classification, regression, tree-based models, SVMs, ensemble methods, and optimization techniques. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust analytical designs and production-ready models. * Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating data scientists on complex projects. * Successful completion of background and drug screening.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* PhD or Master’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. * Deep expertise in advanced machine learning algorithms and modern ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Strong experience writing, optimizing, and tuning complex SQL queries. * Experience designing and maintaining data science pipelines and workflows in Python, R, or similar languages. * Experience working with financial or regulated data environments. * Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities. * Track record of discovering non-obvious insights and patterns in complex datasets.
Physical Requirements
Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.
**The Base Pay Scale For This Position In** Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $150,000 - $200,000.
New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $210,000 - $270,000.
Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.
This pay scale is subject to change and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific candidate, which is always dependent on legitimate factors considered at the time of job offer. Early Warning Services takes into consideration a variety of factors when determining a competitive salary offer, including, but not limited to, the job scope, market rates and geographic location of a position, candidate’s education, experience, training, and specialized skills or certification(s) in relation to the job requirements and compared with internal equity (peers). The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes.
Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness
* Healthcare Coverage – Competitive medical (PPO/HDHP), dental, and vision plans as well as company contributions to your Health Savings Account (HSA) or pre-tax savings through flexible spending accounts (FSA) for commuting, health & dependent care expenses. * 401(k) Retirement Plan – Featuring a 100% Company Safe Harbor Match on your first 6% deferral immediately upon eligibility. * Paid Time Off – Flexible Time Off for Exempt (salaried) employees, as well as generous PTO for Non-Exempt (hourly) employees, plus 11

item.title: AI Data Scientist Technical Leader (Hybrid) - Cisco
item.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/30/2026
This is a hybrid role based thrice a week in Cisco's San Jose, CA office.
**Meet The Team** We are seeking a highly skilled AI Data Scientist / Data Analyst to join our Silicon One Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will leverage sophisticated analytics, machine learning, and AI agent technologies to drive yield analysis, debug, and predictive modeling for our semiconductor manufacturing processes. Your work will directly impact product quality, test cost, manufacturing efficiency, and time-to-market for Cisco’s industry-leading silicon solutions.
**Your Impact**
* Develop, deploy, and maintain AI/ML models for yield analysis, yield debug, and early-stage failure prediction in semiconductor manufacturing. * Build and optimize AI agents to automate data-driven root cause analysis and yield improvement initiatives. * Analyze large-scale manufacturing, test, and parametric datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights. * Collaborate with hardware, test, and process engineering teams to translate business and technical requirements into robust data science solutions. * Design and implement predictive models to forecast yield and quality metrics at various stages of the manufacturing flow. * Communicate findings and recommendations to multi-functional teams through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations. * Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, data analytics, and semiconductor manufacturing best practices. * Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
**Minimum Qualifications**
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or data analytics, preferably in semiconductor or hardware engineering environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Experience building, validating, and deploying AI/ML models for classification, regression, anomaly detection, and time-series forecasting. * Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks and automation of data analysis workflows. * Solid understanding of semiconductor manufacturing, test data, and yield analysis concepts. * Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., matplotlib, seaborn, Tableau, Power BI).
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies. * Familiarity with Optuna or other hyperparameter optimization frameworks. * Knowledge of hardware debug, root cause analysis, and reliability engineering.
Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

item.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, AWS Applied AI Solutions - Amazon Web Services (AWS)
item.description:
**Description** AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
Just Walk Out (JWO) is a new kind of store with no lines and no checkout-you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!
Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you're done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we'll charge your account and send you a receipt. Check it out at amazon.com/go. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems, and hardware design.
Key job responsibilities
* Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment that's more startup than big company. We'll need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains: computer vision, image recognition, machine learning, real-time and distributed systems. * As a Sr. Applied Scientist you will help solve a variety of technical challenges and mentor other scientists. You will be the thought leader of the team. You will tackle challenging novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative you'll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that's higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that frankly haven't been solved at scale before - anywhere. Along the way we guarantee that you'll learn a ton, have fun, and make a positive impact on millions of people. * Develop a novel framework and advance the theory and practice of multi-object tracking, re-identification, person activity understanding, multi-modal foundation model, and generic video understanding. Create innovative techniques for efficient visual processing that can scale to real-world applications. Investigate approaches to reduce the computational and data requirements of visual AI systems.
**About The Team** Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

item.title: Lead Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth - OpenAI
item.description:
**About The Team** Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.
**About The Role** In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.
A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.
**In This Role, You Will**
* Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth. * Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API. * Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage. * Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider. * Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.
**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**
* Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest. * Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.
**Qualifications**
* Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision. * Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads. * Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business. * Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.
**About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

item.description:
**About Slickdeals:** We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.
We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution, transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast moving, collaborative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you'll fit right in.
**The Purpose:** Slickdeals is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to help shape how we grow by partnering with Product, Design, Engineering, Finance, and Marketing to deepen our quantitative understanding of what drives user growth. In this role, you'll combine data science, statistics, and causal inference to develop the frameworks and insights that inform product decisions and shape our growth strategy. As a trusted cross functional partner, you'll turn complex business questions into actionable insights that help us build products our users love.
**What You'll Do:**
* Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Finance, and Marketing to inform product development and growth strategy through data driven insights. * Identify new opportunities, define success metrics, quantify business challenges, and turn open ended questions into structured, high impact analytics projects. * Build scalable measurement frameworks, including lifetime value (LTV) and retention models, to evaluate growth initiatives and support data driven decision making. * Design, execute, and interpret A/B tests to evaluate product changes and validate hypotheses using causal inference, machine learning methodologies, and experimentation best practices. * Develop dashboards and reporting that make key metrics and insights accessible and actionable across the organization. * Translate complex analyses into clear narratives, recommendations, and data stories that influence both technical and non technical stakeholders. * Collaborate across teams to strengthen the data foundation that supports user growth and experimentation at scale.
**What We're Looking For:**
* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Sciences, or another quantitative field. * 8+ years of experience with Masters or 5+ years of experience with PhD * Strong track record designing, executing, and interpreting A/B tests using causal inference methodologies. * Proficiency in SQL and Python or R, with experience working with large scale datasets and data visualization tools. * Proven experience translating data into actionable recommendations for executives and cross functional teams. * Strong analytical mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and uncover meaningful insights from complex business problems. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in fast paced, cross functional environments.
**LOCATION: San Mateo, CA** *Hybrid schedule visiting San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).* **Slickdeals Compensation, Benefits, Perks:** The expected base pay for this role is between $175,000 - $205,000. **Work Authorization** Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.
Slickdeals is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other protected status. item.title: Metrology Data Scientist - VoltForce
item.description:
**Metrology Data Scientist – Signal Modeling & Applied Metrology** **Location:** San Leandro, CA (in-office)
**Team:** Applications Engineering
**About The Company** VoltForce is working with an early-stage materials-inspection company on the search for a Metrology Data Scientist. Our client helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-scale materials, the building blocks of critical sectors like energy storage, semiconductors, aerospace, and power systems. As demand surges and production grows more complex and faster, small undetected variations during manufacturing lead to waste, lower performance, higher cost, and safety risk, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind.
The company's platform changes that. It scans materials without damaging them, pairing a novel sensing approach with physics-informed machine learning to capture real-time signals that conventional methods cannot access. Those signals give manufacturers rare visibility into how materials behave as they are made.
The company turns that hidden data into actionable intelligence, helping manufacturers reduce variability and increase yield and performance. The platform can run as a standalone tool or integrate directly into production lines, and it is already in early deployment with leading global manufacturers.
**About The Role** We are seeking a Metrology Data Scientist to join the Applications Engineering team. In this role, you will build and deploy machine learning models that turn complex, high-dimensional sensor signals into actionable predictions about material properties, bridging the gap between raw instrument data and the intelligence manufacturers act on.
This is a forward-deployed, customer-adjacent role. You will work directly with customer samples and datasets to execute proof-of-concept studies, validate model performance on novel materials, and translate results into product improvements. You will collaborate closely with software and hardware engineering teams to move models from research into production.
**What You'll Do** **Model Development & Calibration**
* Build, calibrate, and validate predictive models that map sensor signal features to material properties * Design and evaluate new model architectures and featurization strategies suited to small-data, high-dimensional scientific datasets * Apply methods including regression, dimensionality reduction, probabilistic modeling, anomaly detection, and physics-informed ML
**Model Validation & Production Readiness**
* Develop testing and validation frameworks for model performance, including uncertainty quantification and out-of-distribution detection * Characterize model robustness across sample types, process conditions, and instrument configurations * Prepare models and documentation for handoff to the software engineering team for production deployment
**Customer-Facing Proof-of-Concept Work**
* Analyze datasets from customer proof of concepts * Compile technical reports and supporting materials to deliver to customers * Translate findings and stakeholder feedback into model improvement roadmaps
**Required** **What You Bring**
* B.S. in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field with 3 to 5 years of applied ML/data science experience; or M.S. with 1 to 3 years (Ph.D. a plus, not required). MINIMUM of 1 year post-graduation industry experience required * Hands-on experience building and validating predictive models (supervised and self-supervised) in Python * Ability to analyze multivariate, high-dimensional datasets and perform feature engineering and selection * Solid grasp of statistical modeling: uncertainty quantification, regularization, covariate analysis, and feature importance methods * Strong communicator, comfortable presenting technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
**Preferred**
* Experience working with time-series, spectroscopic, or other sensor-based signal data * Prior work in manufacturing, materials science, energy storage, semiconductors, or another physical science domain * Prior customer-facing or applications engineering experience in a technical product company * Experience deploying models in production software environments * Familiarity with data pipeline development (PostgreSQL or similar) * Fluency in Mandarin Chinese, Japanese, German, Korean, or another key stakeholder language
It's ok if you don't check all the boxes. We hire for the capacity and the drive to learn and grow. If there is something you haven't done, but you are capable, please apply!
VoltForce does not work on a Corp-to-Corp (C2C) basis.

item.title: Staff Applied Scientist - LinkedIn
item.description:
LinkedIn is the worlds largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. Were also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture thats built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun where everyone can succeed. Join us to transform the way the world works.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
LinkedIn’s Data Science and Applied Science teams use data, experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and AI to solve important product and business problems. With more than 1 billion members globally and products that span both consumer and enterprise use cases, LinkedIn offers scientists the opportunity to work on problems that directly shape member experience, customer value, growth, and monetization.
We are looking for a strong individual contributor who can bring rigorous science to practical problems. In this role, you will work across areas such as experimentation, causal inference, prediction, measurement, optimization, personalization, and large-scale machine learning. You will be expected to go deep technically, build methods and models that fit real product needs, and turn promising ideas into tools, platforms, and systems that can be used at scale.
The ideal candidate combines technical depth with strong product and business judgment. You should be comfortable developing methods from the ground up, adapting existing techniques to new problems, and working closely with cross-functional partners to make better decisions and deliver measurable impact. item.title: Data Scientist II - Crunchyroll
item.description:
**About Crunchyroll** Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
**About The Role** We are seeking an exceptional Data Scientist II to join our Machine Learning and Data Science team, with a focus on supporting and shaping content strategy through rigorous statistical analysis, traditional machine learning, and predictive modeling. This role will partner closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, content strategists, product leaders, and business stakeholders to develop models and insights that inform how we understand audiences, evaluate content performance, forecast outcomes, and optimize decision-making across the content lifecycle. We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles, CA or San Francisco, CA.
The ideal candidate will have experience in traditional machine learning methods, strong statistical foundations, and hands-on experience working with large-scale behavioral and content datasets. Key areas of focus will include user clustering and segmentation, behavioral modeling, content performance analysis, time series forecasting, audience engagement prediction, and KPI forecasting across acquisition, viewership, retention, monetization, and lifecycle outcomes.
This is a cross-functional role for someone who is both technically rigorous and commercially curious. Success in this position requires strong judgment in model selection, feature engineering, validation, experimentation, and interpretation, as well as the ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. The right candidate will bring a strong command of machine learning fundamentals and a passion for using data to better understand users, content, and the dynamics that drive long-term engagement.
**What You Will Do:**
* Develop and implement machine learning models that support content strategy, including user clustering, behavioral segmentation, engagement prediction, content affinity modeling, and audience lifecycle analysis. * Analyze large-scale user behavior, content consumption, and performance datasets to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that inform content investment, programming, personalization, and growth strategies. * Apply traditional machine learning techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, tree-based models, ensemble methods, survival analysis, uplift modeling, and time series forecasting to solve complex business problems. * Design feature engineering, model validation, backtesting, and evaluation frameworks to ensure models are accurate, interpretable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. * Partner with content, finance, strategy, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous business questions into structured data science problems and actionable recommendations. * Collaborate with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Engineers to productionize models, improve data pipelines, and ensure reliable, repeatable workflows across data science initiatives. * Document methodologies, assumptions, experiments, model outputs, and business implications clearly to support transparency, collaboration, and stakeholder adoption. * Stay current with advances in statistical modeling, machine learning, forecasting, behavioral analytics, and content intelligence, and natural language processing while maintaining a strong grounding in proven, interpretable modeling techniques.
**About You** We get excited about candidates, like you, because:
* You have 2+ years of experience in data science roles, preferably in technology, media, entertainment, streaming, subscription, or consumer product environments. You have demonstrated success applying data science to user behavior modeling, audience segmentation, content performance analysis, forecasting, personalization, lifecycle analytics, or related applications. * You have a strong command of traditional machine learning methods and know when and how to apply them effectively. You are experienced with techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, tree-based models, ensemble methods, survival analysis, uplift modeling, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting. * You are comfortable working with large-scale behavioral, engagement, and content consumption datasets. You can identify meaningful user segments, model content affinity and engagement patterns, evaluate title or catalog performance, and translate behavioral signals into actionable insights for content, product, growth, and strategy teams. * You are proficient in Python for data analysis and modeling, SQL for querying and transforming data, and visualization tools such as Tableau, matplotlib, or similar platforms. You have hands-on experience with machine learning libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, statsmodels, PyTorch, or similar tools. * You have experience building, validating, and communicating predictive models for business outcomes such as viewership, acquisition, retention, engagement, churn, monetization, or content ROI. You understand model evaluation, backtesting, feature engineering, interpretability, and the importance of aligning technical metrics with business goals. * You are adept at presenting complex analytical and machine learning findings in clear, actionable formats for both technical and non-technical audiences. You can explain methodology, assumptions, model outputs, tradeoffs, and business implications through concise narratives, dashboards, reports, and visualizations. * You hold a degree in data science, statistics, computer science, economics, mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field. A master’s degree or advanced coursework in machine learning, statistics, econometrics, behavioral science, natural language processing, or related areas is preferred.
**About The Team** You will join an interdisciplinary team of Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and AI Engineers, united by a passion for leveraging data and ML/AI to create transformative solutions. item.title: Principal Data & Applied Scientist – Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs & AI Research - SAP
item.description:
**Job Description** **Teach AI how business actually works** AI agents are starting to take on real business work: releasing blocked invoices, re-planning supply, preparing the financial close. To do it safely, they need more than access to data. They need to know what an order, a supplier and a cost center are, how they connect, which rules and authorizations apply, and what happened the last time someone made a similar decision. When executing mission-critical business processes, an answer or action that is right 90% of the time is not good enough.
SAP systems hold the context for many of the world's largest companies. SAP's knowledge graph for SAP S/4HANA alone is based on 452,000 tables, 80,000 CDS views (semantic data models) and 7.3 million fields. Yet much of the meaning, especially in each company's own extensions, configuration and decision history, is still implicit. A 'customer' in sales, a 'business partner' in finance and an 'account' in CRM can be the same company described three ways, and an agent deciding whether to raise a credit limit has to know that. This is not a data-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP's AI workspace, accurate enough to trust.
As Principal Data Scientist, you will define and lead our research toward that goal and work with product teams to ship the results. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics.
**What You Will Work On**
* A research agenda with a point of view. Pick the two or three bets where SAP can lead in AI on business data, agree up front how we will know each one is working, and stop the ones that aren't. Closely collaborate with top universities and institutes such as Stanford HAI. * What comes next. Track emerging research, such as relational and graph foundation models, neuro-symbolic agents and context graphs, test it on SAP data before the market settles, and make the case for the next bet. * Business semantics that can be learned. New methods to learn, align and evolve ontologies and knowledge graphs of business objects, rules and actions from SAP metadata, master data, documents and process data, combining LLM-assisted ontology learning, schema matching and entity resolution with targeted expert review. * Agents grounded in business semantics. Graph-grounded retrieval; semantic parsing into SQL, SPARQL and OData calls, including finding the right API, across very large schemas; and governed actions: checks that an agent's plan respects business rules and the user's authorizations before it runs. * Models that combine structure and statistics. Graph learning and relational foundation models (such as SAP-RPT-1.6), using knowledge-graph structure to predict, explain and simulate business outcomes. * The yardstick. Benchmarks and simulation environments for agents on ERP data, where today's public benchmarks fall short, so SAP knows when AI is accurate and reliable enough to act on. * Results that land. Work directly with data teams and domain experts in co-innovation projects, turning messy enterprise data problems into tractable ontology problems, and work with the teams behind SAP Knowledge Graph, SAP Business Data Cloud and Joule, SAP's AI assistant, to ship what works. * A stronger research community. Publish at top venues, release code and benchmarks where we can, co-lead university collaborations, and mentor scientists and PhD interns.
**In Your First Year, Success Could Look Like**
* Two or three research directions you defined, agreed with leadership, at least one with a product partner and one longer-horizon * A result running in an SAP product or pilot * Papers submitted, and a benchmark or open-source release others use * Scientists doing better work because of you
**Qualifications** **What you'll bring** **Required**
* Typically 8+ years in applied research, data science or machine learning, or a PhD and 5+ years, including research you led that changed a product or platform. An MS or PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Deep expertise in one of these areas and hands-on experience in another, with at least one of the two in knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic data integration:
+ Knowledge graphs, ontologies and semantic data integration: RDF, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL or property graphs; ontology and schema matching; entity resolution; semantic layers; you have made the hard modeling calls yourself (entity boundaries, inheritance, relationship semantics), not just queried existing graphs + Machine learning on relational, graph or tabular data: GNNs, relational deep learning, relational or tabular foundation models + LLM systems over structured data: retrieval, tool and API discovery, text-to-SQL and schema linking, tool-using agents, fine-tuning or post-training + Evaluation and benchmark design for AI systems
* Strong foundations in machine learning and statistics; fluent in Python and SQL, with PyTorch or JAX; at ease with schemas spanning thousands of related tables. * Strong problem solving skills, shown by concrete examples: you have turned an ambiguous business question into a crisp, testable research problem, started with the simplest approach that could work, and stopped or redirected work, including your own, when the evidence said so. * Strong communication skills, shown by concrete examples: you can explain a trade-off to an executive concisely and clearly. A paper, design doc or memo of yours led a team outside your own to adopt, fund or drop something. You are able to work through a design with skeptical engineers.
**Preferred**
* Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ACL/EMNLP, SIGMOD/VLDB, ISWC, WWW, or widely used open-source software, datasets or semantic standards work. * LLM-assisted ontology learning, neuro-symbolic methods, agent memory, context graphs and decision traces, or reinforcement learning for tool-using agents. * Process mining (including object-centric event data), causal inference, forecasting, or privacy-preserving and synthetic data. * Familiarity with how enterprises run (finance, supply chain, procurement, HR), and experience mentoring scientists or leading university collaborations. * SAP experience is a plus, not a requirement.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools, including agentic AI, in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.
If you recognize yourself here but do not match every line, apply.
**Where you belong** We are SAP Research & Innovation North America, a team of scientists and engineers at SAP Labs in Palo Alto, minutes from Stanford. We look a few years ahead and scout emerging technologies, take the early, riskier bets that product teams can’t always take, and prove or drop them fast. SAP's product teams build and run SAP Knowledge Graph, we look beyond and find and prove methods that demonstrate improvement or paradigm shifts. Our job is to spot the opportunities that will matter most to SAP and our customers, and to get there early. We prototype with dedicated GPU compute on realistic business data and, in co-innovation projects, on real data for training and evaluating models. We publish research, work with startups, universities and institutes including Stanford HAI and UC Irvine, and hand what works to SAP's product teams. We move like a small lab, with the reach of a company whose software runs finance

item.title: Principal Data Scientist, Creator - Roblox
item.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
**WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?** The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency, and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling, and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive toolbelt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products, and measure impact on our community of players and creators.
**WHY CREATOR?** At Roblox, the Creator team is responsible for the systems that determine how creators generate and distribute games, license and share their IP, protect against clones, and thrive on the platform. As we move into a new era of AI tooling, game creation becomes much more accessible to a broad audience. We need to develop new tools and products to harness these new capabilities, and put new thought into protection against clones. As a Principal Data Scientist, you will be the primary strategic data partner across some of the most business-critical areas in the Creator space.
This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role. You will work across economy, measurement, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled analytics — owning end-to-end problem framing, model development, and executive-facing recommendations in areas that directly shape platform integrity and creator success.
**You Will**
* Drive Build Analytics: Develop and refine the suite of metrics used to track product success for Build — our new platform for generating games directly from user prompts. Define success metrics, guardrail metrics, and directly inform the product direction, from model spec decisions, to UI improvements, to pricing structure. * Own Clone Detection: Serve as the primary DS owner for clone detection modeling and consequencing — developing systems that distinguish between derivatives and full-on clones, and informing policies for how to intervene when clones are discovered. Innovate on which signals to use to identify clones in production. * Own IP Licensing Measurement: establish framework for tracking adoption and impact of IP licensing. Help define the strategy for broader IP sharing, through avatars and licensed assets. * Drive Creator Data Foundations: Serve as DRI for core creator data infrastructure — documenting all key creator tables, designing trustworthy data contracts, and building the semantic layers and analytical frameworks that enable reliable self-serve analysis across the team. * Enable Agentic & AI-Powered Analytics: Lead DS AI enablement for the creator org — building skills, evaluation frameworks, and scalable AI-enabled workflows that reduce analyst toil and elevate the team's analytical capacity. * Create Zero-to-One Frameworks: Define analytical standards and measurement approaches for new, ambiguous product areas — translating complex technical systems into interpretable, movable metrics for product and engineering leadership.
**You Have**
* Seniority & Breadth: Principal DS experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-functional data problems end-to-end — from problem framing and data infrastructure through modeling, experimentation, and executive communication. * Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate technical findings into clear product and business recommendations for senior executives. Experience interacting directly with VPs and Senior VPs. * Comfort with Ambiguity: Experience operating independently in zero-to-one environments — defining the problem, building the data, and owning the answer without a playbook. * Technical Leadership: Ideally, someone who can raise the bar for adjacent DS workstreams through mentorship, code review, and cross-functional partnership. * ML & Generative AI Chops: Proven ability to build, evaluate, and maintain ML models, especially for game generation and asset similarity modeling. Experience with ecosystem or marketplace settings is a strong plus. * Experimentation & Causal Inference: Strong statistical rigor, experimentation design, and causal inference skills — ideally applied in complex, mediated settings where simple A/B tests don't tell the full story. * AI for Analytics: Deep understanding of agentic and self-serve analytics use cases, including how to turn DS workflows into scalable, AI-enabled products. Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for AI outputs. * Data Foundation Expertise: Ability to contribute to the data foundation layer for AI — including table documentation, semantic layer design, data contracts, and trustworthy infrastructure for AI-enabled analysis. * Technical Depth: Expert-level SQL and Python, with enough engineering fluency to work effectively across data pipelines, model outputs, and production-facing systems. * Academic Background: BS, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page** .
Annual Salary Range
$322,820—$373,680 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist, Medical Imaging - Heartflow
item.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.
Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with a strong foundation in both statistical data analysis and deep learning to drive our data-centric AI initiatives. In this role, you will be at the forefront of understanding how diverse real-world imaging conditions and technical variables affect image appearance and, in turn, the accuracy and reproducibility of deep learning algorithms.
You will own the analytical pipeline to quantify these effects and explore data-driven methods to address them. You will work cross-functionally to translate these insights into downstream algorithm development and product decision-making, including development of annotation protocols to curate high quality annotations for training and validation. If you are drawn to deriving insight from large and messy real-world imaging data, and to communicating and crystalizing solutions from these insights, this is the role for you.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Tooling & Pipelines: Build robust, reproducible analytical pipelines and visualizations over population-scale data, to characterise dataset distributions and model vulnerabilities across diverse patient populations. * Correction & Harmonization: Explore, develop, and validate methods for harmonizing complex data-related factors and image variations. * Data-Centric Deep Learning: Translate findings about data variance and model behaviour into actionable data curation requirements, training-time robustness strategies, and architectural recommendations for downstream algorithm development. * Data Curation and Annotation: Develop annotation protocols for algorithm training and validation for internal product development and FDA submissions. * Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Partner with Research Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Systems Engineers, Process Engineers, Product and Regulatory teams. Derive and present clear analyses from messy data to drive decision-making, and provide artifacts other functions consume.
**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Masters or PhD Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Medical Image Analysis, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * Experience: 5+ years (or 3+ with a PhD) of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Image Analysis. * Measurement Science: Working command of reproducibility and agreement statistics — variance components, Gage R&R, intraclass correlation, repeatability and reproducibility coefficients, Bland-Altman — and the judgement to separate correctable bias from irreducible variance. * Medical Imaging Expertise: Deep understanding of medical image data structures and the physical/clinical realities of imaging. Familiarity with image processing tools and building algorithms for medical imaging data. * Data Analysis & Statistics: Expert proficiency in Python and statistical data analysis ecosystems (e.g., pandas, scipy, statsmodels, seaborn/matplotlib). Proven ability with large, complex, and messy datasets. * Deep Learning Experience: Hands-on experience developing or fine-tuning deep learning algorithms (preferably using PyTorch) for computer vision tasks (segmentation, classification, detection) applied to medical images. * AI-Augmented Workflow: Demonstrated proficiency using modern agentic tools and LLMs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude) as a daily force multiplier to accelerate software development, rapidly prototype data solutions, and build reproducible pipelines. * Communication: Exceptional ability to distill complex, multi-dimensional data analyses into clear, strategic insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Published research specifically related to domain generalization, image harmonization, or out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging. * Experience working with large multi-vendor CT imaging datasets, with an understanding of acquisition and reconstruction protocols. * Proven track-record in diagnosing data- and annotation-related algorithm performance gaps, and designing data-driven solutions. * Experience with large-scale data querying and cloud storage (e.g., AWS, SQL). * Experience developing SaMD products and contributing to regulatory filings. * Experience with biostats to support FDA submissions.
**A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is* *$170,000 to*
*$240,000, bonus, and equity.** Heartflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at Heartflow, including recruitment, hiring, training, relocation, promotion, and termination.
Positions posted for Heartflow are not intended for or open to third party recruiters / agencies. Submission of any unsolicited resumes for these positions will be considered to be free referrals.
Heartflow has become aware of a fraud where unknown entities are posing as Heartflow recruiters in an attempt to obtain personal information from individuals as part of our application or job offer process. Before providing any personal information to outside parties, please verify the following: A) all legitimate Heartflow recruiter email addresses end with “@heartflow.com” and B) the position described is found on our careers site at www.heartflow.com/about/careers/.

item.title: Senior Data Scientist - Grifols
item.description:

Leads and advises data analysis aspects of the setup, evaluation, and interpretation of longitudinal and high-dimensional omics and RWE datasets. Education:
• Ph.D.
Experience:

Equivalency:

Frequent hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists. Occasionally walks and stands. Occasionally bends and twists neck. Light to moderate lifting and carrying objects with a maximum lift of 25lbs. Frequently drives to site locations with occasional travel within the United States. item.title: Data Scientist, Acquisition - Superhuman
item.description:
*Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.* **About Superhuman** Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.
The Opportunity
Turn complex data into growth decisions that shape the future of Superhuman’s product suite.
As an Acquisition Data Scientist at Superhuman, you’ll shape how we acquire, activate, and expand our user base across a diverse portfolio of consumer and enterprise products. You’ll partner directly with Acquisition Marketing to improve the effectiveness of paid and organic channels, optimize the web funnel, and ensure every marketing dollar drives measurable growth.
Your work will span the Superhuman product suite, including Grammarly, Mail, Docs, Databases, GPTZero, Fathom, and Go. Because we’re building an integrated platform rather than a collection of standalone tools, insights from one product can unlock growth across the portfolio. You’ll tackle questions spanning budget allocation, channel attribution, SEO, AEO, cross-product activation, bundled offerings, and the full self-serve journey from first touch through activation and viral expansion.
You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional pod aligned to a Route to Market, working closely with Engineering, Finance, Marketing, Design, and User Research. With direct access to the leaders setting strategy, you’ll serve as the go-to data partner for acquisition: getting into the technical details, translating complex findings into clear recommendations on channel optimization, budget decisions, and new growth areas.
This role is for a hands-on data scientist who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving complex growth problems, and wants their work to measurably influence outcomes across products, audiences, and go-to-market motions.
What you’ll do
* Be the go-to data person working directly with our Acquisition Marketing team, helping drive the efficacy of their marketing spend across our core paid and organic channels. This role is for someone who wants to be extremely hands-on, enjoys partnering cross-functionally with marketing peers, and wants to get deep into the technical weeds to find the best recommendations to ensure we optimize every marketing dollar we spend. * Be the embedded data science partner for the Superhuman Acquisition Marketing team — shaping channel strategy, budget allocation, prioritization, and roadmap decisions with evidence, not just fielding ad hoc requests. * Define and own the metrics that matter for Acquisition: LTV/CAC, new user growth, lifetime value, and web conversion rates to ensure we are responsible with our ad spend and driving continued conversion optimization. * Design and run incrementality tests across our most critical acquisition channels like Google, Meta, and YouTube. * Find opportunities for new user growth through budget reinvestment, new acquisition sources, international expansion, and website optimization. * Partner with our Acquisition, Engineering, Design, User Research, and Finance teams to build functional roadmaps for optimization of our acquisition channels across paid and organic sources. * Use data to craft a narrative, tell a story, and influence decisions to improve the efficiency of our ad channels and drive meaningful new user growth.
**Qualifications**
* You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers. * Advanced expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including designing incrementality tests and translating results into acquisition investment decisions. * Demonstrated ability to develop marketing mix and budget allocation models that measure channel effectiveness, identify diminishing returns, and optimize acquisition spend across channels. * You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions. * You influence cross-functional partners and turn technical insight into action through clear communication, empathetic building, and openness to ideas from anywhere. * You’re a self-starting, creative problem-solver who distills problems to their core and thrives with ambiguity. * You’re comfortable using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code or Codex to move faster, and you have the judgment to validate and supervise their output. * You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, data science, or a similar field); an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
**Nice To Haves**
* Familiarity working with ad platforms across Google, Meta, and YouTube. * Experience with SEO and AEO optimization and organic acquisition channels. * You’re familiar with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and modern data stacks such as Databricks. * You have experience working at a fast-growing startup, on AI-native consumer products, and/or in B2B/SaaS.
**Compensation And Benefits** Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:
* Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities
Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations.
Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.
We encourage you to apply
At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).
